verdict.rationale: Phaser is a game framework/library, and its only AI-agent-related offering (the Game Agent) is documented as an MCP SERVER that external coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Copilot) connect to and call tools from — not a client role where Phaser itself consumes other MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence, and no plausible product surface, for Phaser acting as an MCP client plugging in third-party servers, so this axis is a category error for this product.
